posts.zh:
tongflow#dsh-tongflow 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。基于 TongFlow 的“片场”插件，用于图片、配音、音乐与视频制作：agent 为每个资产生成 TongFlow 工作流文件（.tongflow.json）并通过 TongFlow 插件执行，内嵌工作流画布，按镜头/角色/take 组织项目，附漫剧模板；以 @tongflow 开头的会话进入 Studio 界面。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b4f256b8f3d64db19bb5.html
posts.en:
tongflow#dsh-tongflow is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. TongFlow film-crew studio for image, voice, music and video production: the agent writes per-asset TongFlow workflow files (.tongflow.json) that run through TongFlow plugins, with an embedded workflow canvas, a shot/character/take project layout and a manga-drama template; sessions starting with @tongflow open the Studio view.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b4f256b8f3d64db19bb5.html
